questions.question: The director, along with his entire cast, ____ ready for the premiere.

options.explanation: Incorrect because the main subject is singular.

questions.explanation: When a subject is followed by phrases like "along with," "as well as," "in addition to," or "together with," the verb agrees with the main subject ("director"), which is singular.

questions.question: **Case-Based Question:** Read the following paragraph and choose the option that correctly fills in all the blanks: "The research data, which (i) ____ collected over several months, (ii) ____ now being analyzed. Each of the researchers (iii) ____ confident about the findings. However, a significant portion of the raw material (iv) ____ still missing."

options.explanation: Correct because all the blanks are filled with the correct singular verbs.
Incorrect because all the subjects are singular.
Incorrect because subject (ii) should be singular.
Incorrect because subjects (i), (iii), and (iv) should be singular.

questions.explanation: (i) "data" (uncountable noun in this context, treated singularly in modern usage, especially with "research data") "which was collected" (referring to the singular "data"). (ii) "The research data... is now being analyzed." (Subject "data" is singular). (iii) "Each of the researchers is confident." ("Each" is singular). (iv) "a significant portion of the raw material is still missing." ("Portion" refers to "raw material" which is uncountable and singular).
questions.subject: maha12-english
